title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 2, QA) - Quant - Speed Time Distance Races
subject: Quant

questions.q: A bus starts at 9 am and follows a fixed route. One day, it traveled at 60 km/h and reached 3.5 hours late. The next day, it traveled two-thirds of its route in one-third of its total scheduled travel time, and the remaining part at 40 km/h to reach just on time. The scheduled arrival time is
questions.explain: Let distance be D and scheduled time T. From day 1, $D/60 = T+3.5$. On day 2, it travels $2D/3$ in $T/3$ time, so speed is $(2D/3)/(T/3) = 2D/T$. The remaining $D/3$ is travelled at 40 km/h, taking time $(D/3)/40 = D/120$. Total time on day 2 is $T/3 + D/120 = T$. So $D/120 = 2T/3 \implies D = 80T$. Substitute this into the first equation: $80T/60 = T+3.5 \implies 4T/3 = T+3.5 \implies T/3=3.5 \implies T=10.5$ hours. Bus starts at 9 am. Scheduled arrival time is 9 am + 10.5 hours = 7:30 pm.
